extensionDescription.message: Change YouTube playback speed from the header with one click. Customize a cycle of 2–5 speeds and the logo click action.

intro.message: Change YouTube playback speed with one click.

usageHelp.message: Click the numbered button between the YouTube logo and the search box.

speedPersistence.message: The number shows the playback speed. It stays the same when switching videos and resets to 1.0× when you reload the page.

settingsHelp.message: In settings, choose 2–5 speeds in 0.05× increments. Clicking the “ド” logo can advance to the next speed, reset to 1.0×, or do nothing.

nativeHelp.message: YouTube’s built-in speed controls also work. The button reflects the speed you select.

privacySummary.message: No personal information or watch history is collected or sent to external servers.

unofficial.message: Not an official YouTube or Google product.

speedsHelp.message: Choose 2–5 speeds from 0.25× to 4.0× in 0.05× increments. Speeds cycle from top to bottom, then return to the first entry.

numberHelp.message: Clicking the number always advances to the next speed.

settingsFooter.message: Preferences are saved on this device and applied to open YouTube tabs. Saving does not change the current playback speed.

errorSpeedDuplicate.message: Each playback speed must be unique.

errorLogoAction.message: Choose an action for the “ド” logo.

errorOpenSettings.message: Could not open settings. Close and reopen the popup.

settingsSaved.message: Saved. Preferences also apply to open YouTube tabs.

errorSaveSettings.message: Could not save settings. Please try again.

errorLoadSettings.message: Could not load settings. Please reload this page.
